name: Mocu Browser Bridge
description: Lets Mocu agents inspect and control Google Chrome through a local browser extension connection.

commands.title: Open a Chrome tab
commands.description: Open a new Google Chrome tab. Input: {url?: string, active?: boolean}. Omit url to open Google. URLs must use HTTP or HTTPS.

commands.title: Navigate a Chrome tab
commands.description: Navigate an existing tab. Input: {url: string, tabId?: number}. Omit tabId to use the active tab. Only HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported.

commands.title: List Chrome tabs
commands.description: List open Chrome tabs. Input: {}. Returns tabId, title, URL, active state, and windowId for each tab.

commands.title: Read a Chrome page
commands.description: Read the selected or active tab. Input: {tabId?: number, includeHtml?: boolean, includeElements?: boolean}. Returns title, URL, visible text (up to 60,000 characters), and optionally bounded HTML and controls.

commands.title: List interactive page elements
commands.description: Find visible links, buttons, inputs, selects, and controls. Input: {tabId?: number, limit?: number}. Returns CSS selectors and labels. Use this before clicking or filling a page element.

commands.title: Read a page element
commands.description: Read one element selected by CSS. Input: {selector: string, tabId?: number, index?: number, mode?: 'summary'|'text'|'value'|'html'|'attribute', attribute?: string}. Returns only the requested element data.

commands.title: Click a page element
commands.description: Click an element selected by CSS. Input: {selector: string, tabId?: number, index?: number}. First inspect the page and use an element selector. Clicking can trigger real site actions or submit a form.

commands.title: Fill a page field
commands.description: Fill an input, textarea, select, or contenteditable field. Input: {selector: string, value: string, tabId?: number}. Choose the selector from listInteractiveElements or readPage.

commands.title: Execute JavaScript in a page
commands.description: Run task-specific JavaScript in a tab's main page context. Input: {code: string, tabId?: number}. Return a JSON-serializable value. JavaScript can change data or trigger real actions; use only as needed for the user's request.

commands.title: Get browser bridge status
commands.description: Check whether the local bridge is running and Chrome is connected. Input: {}.

commands.title: Start browser bridge
commands.description: Start the local Chrome bridge if it is stopped. Input: {}.

commands.title: Stop browser bridge
commands.description: Stop the local connection and disconnect Chrome. Input: {}.
